label: common_2080_rival_02
text: You’ve gotta go through the application process\nwith a staffer before you can actually participate\r\nin the tournament![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2080_rival_03
text: Ready for that explanation now, mister![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2080_staff_01
text:
All right. The rules of the Academy Ace
Tournament are as follows:\c
Any student or faculty member of the academy
may enter. Your opponents will be random, and
only winners will advance to the next round!

label: common_2080_staff_02
text: Opponents will be matched by lottery, and the\nlottery is run by the people in charge.

label: common_2080_staff_03
text: That means you’ll have no idea who you’ll be\nfacing until you meet them on the battle court!

label: common_2080_staff_04
text: Winners, as I said, will get to advance to the\nnext round.

label: common_2080_staff_05
text: But lose once, and you’re knocked out—no more\nbattles for you after that.

label: common_2080_staff_06
text: The last Trainer standing—the only person to win\nall their matches—will be deemed the best of all,\r\nthe academy’s ace!

label: common_2080_rival_05
text: We hashed out the tournament rules with help\nfrom Director Clavell.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2080_rival_06
text: Based on the number of entrants so far, you’d\nprobably have to win four times to take it all![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2080_rival_07
text: Don’t forget you might go up against the faculty,\ntoo. They’re tough stuff...so good luck and go be\r\neven tougher![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2080_rival_08
text: The only person allowed to beat you is me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2080_staff_07
text: Please talk to me when you’re ready to take part.
